---
paper: auto
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    margin:
      x: 5mm
      y: 5mm
---

`#let qmd-paper = "`{=typst}{{< meta paper >}}`"`{=typst}

```{=typst}
#set page(
  ..(if qmd-paper != "" and qmd-paper != "auto" and not qmd-paper.starts-with("?") {
    (paper: lower(qmd-paper), flipped: true, margin: 5mm, numbering: none)
  } else {
    (width: auto, height: auto, margin: 5mm, numbering: none)
  }),
)
#include "periodic-table.typ"
```
